introduction.text: Hello everyone! I'm AURUS, a robotic companion built by Team TechTitans. I'm a working prototype that brings together movement, vision, voice, and artificial intelligence. Welcome to the Faculty of Information Technology Expo!

movement.text: Let me introduce myself with a little movement. My ultrasonic sensors help me check for nearby obstacles.

turn_left.text: A small turn to the left.

turn_right.text: And a small turn to the right. Hello, everyone!

capabilities.text: You can talk to me and ask questions using my Groq-powered artificial intelligence. I can use my camera to observe my surroundings, recognize people I have learned, and remember facts you choose to share.

closing.text: I'm still a prototype, so my team is continuing to improve me. Thank you for visiting, and enjoy the FIT Expo!

blocked.text: There isn't enough clear space for my movement demonstration, so I'll continue my introduction from here.
